class NonLinearRangeInput {
    constructor(element) {
        this.element = element;
        this.graduations = JSON.parse(this.element.dataset.graduations);

        this.input = this.element.querySelector('input.range-input');
        this.tooltip = this.element.querySelector('.range-tooltip');

        this.onChange = new Event();

        if (!this.graduations.length) {
            console.warn('No graduations defined for a non-linear range input. Has the block been set up correctly in the editor?');
            return;
        }

        /** @var graduationIntervalPercent What value each interval in percent represents, e.g., 20 %, 25 %, 33.33 %, ... */
        this.graduationIntervalPercent = 100 / (this.graduations.length - 1);
        this.absoluteMin = this.graduations[0];
        this.absoluteMax = this.graduations[this.graduations.length - 1];

        this.input.addEventListener('input', () => this.onChange.invoke(this.value));
    }

    get value() {
        return Math.round(this._getAbsoluteFromPercent(this.input.value));
    }

    set value(value) {
        value = Math.max(this.absoluteMin, Math.min(value, this.absoluteMax));
        this.input.value = this._getPercentFromAbsolute(value);

        this._updateRangeBackground();
        this._updateRangeTooltip();
    }

    _getAbsoluteFromPercent(percent) {
        const graduationFloorIndex = Math.floor(percent / this.graduationIntervalPercent);
        const graduationCeilingIndex = Math.min(this.graduations.length - 1, graduationFloorIndex + 1);

        const floorAbsolute = this.graduations[graduationFloorIndex];
        const ceilingAbsolute = this.graduations[graduationCeilingIndex];

        const remainingPercent = percent % this.graduationIntervalPercent;
        const percentThroughGraduation = remainingPercent / (this.graduationIntervalPercent / 100);
        const rangeAbsolute = ceilingAbsolute - floorAbsolute;
        const absoluteValue = (rangeAbsolute * (percentThroughGraduation / 100)) + floorAbsolute;

        return absoluteValue;
    }

    _getPercentFromAbsolute(value) {
        const ceilingIndex = this.graduations.findIndex((graduation) => graduation >= value);

        if (ceilingIndex === 0) return 0;

        const floorAbsolute = this.graduations[Math.max(0, ceilingIndex - 1)];
        const ceilingAbsolute = this.graduations[ceilingIndex];

        const rangeAbsolute = ceilingAbsolute - floorAbsolute;
        const deltaValueAbsolute = value - floorAbsolute;

        const ceilingPercent = this.graduationIntervalPercent * ceilingIndex;
        const percentThroughGraduation = this.graduationIntervalPercent - ((deltaValueAbsolute / rangeAbsolute) * this.graduationIntervalPercent);
        const percentValue = ceilingPercent - percentThroughGraduation;

        return percentValue;
    }

class NonLinearRangeInput {
    constructor(element) {
        this.element = element;
        this.graduations = JSON.parse(this.element.dataset.graduations);

        this.input = this.element.querySelector('input.range-input');
        this.tooltip = this.element.querySelector('.range-tooltip');

        this.onChange = new Event();

        if (!this.graduations.length) {
            console.warn('No graduations defined for a non-linear range input. Has the block been set up correctly in the editor?');
            return;
        }

        /** @var graduationIntervalPercent What value each interval in percent represents, e.g., 20 %, 25 %, 33.33 %, ... */
        this.graduationIntervalPercent = 100 / (this.graduations.length - 1);
        this.absoluteMin = this.graduations[0];
        this.absoluteMax = this.graduations[this.graduations.length - 1];

        this.input.addEventListener('input', () => this.onChange.invoke(this.value));
    }

    get value() {
        return Math.round(this._getAbsoluteFromPercent(this.input.value));
    }

    set value(value) {
        value = Math.max(this.absoluteMin, Math.min(value, this.absoluteMax));
        this.input.value = this._getPercentFromAbsolute(value);

        this._updateRangeBackground();
        this._updateRangeTooltip();
    }

    _getAbsoluteFromPercent(percent) {
        const graduationFloorIndex = Math.floor(percent / this.graduationIntervalPercent);
        const graduationCeilingIndex = Math.min(this.graduations.length - 1, graduationFloorIndex + 1);

        const floorAbsolute = this.graduations[graduationFloorIndex];
        const ceilingAbsolute = this.graduations[graduationCeilingIndex];

        const remainingPercent = percent % this.graduationIntervalPercent;
        const percentThroughGraduation = remainingPercent / (this.graduationIntervalPercent / 100);
        const rangeAbsolute = ceilingAbsolute - floorAbsolute;
        const absoluteValue = (rangeAbsolute * (percentThroughGraduation / 100)) + floorAbsolute;

        return absoluteValue;
    }

    _getPercentFromAbsolute(value) {
        const ceilingIndex = this.graduations.findIndex((graduation) => graduation >= value);

        if (ceilingIndex === 0) return 0;

        const floorAbsolute = this.graduations[Math.max(0, ceilingIndex - 1)];
        const ceilingAbsolute = this.graduations[ceilingIndex];

        const rangeAbsolute = ceilingAbsolute - floorAbsolute;
        const deltaValueAbsolute = value - floorAbsolute;

        const ceilingPercent = this.graduationIntervalPercent * ceilingIndex;
        const percentThroughGraduation = this.graduationIntervalPercent - ((deltaValueAbsolute / rangeAbsolute) * this.graduationIntervalPercent);
        const percentValue = ceilingPercent - percentThroughGraduation;

        return percentValue;
    }

    _updateRangeBackground() {
        const percent = this.input.value;

        this.input.style.background = document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl'
            ? `linear-gradient(to left, var(--color-secondary-cobalt-900) ${percent}%, var(--color-grey-150) ${percent}% 100%)`
            : `linear-gradient(to right, var(--color-secondary-cobalt-900) ${percent}%, var(--color-grey-150) ${percent}% 100%)`;
    }

    _updateRangeTooltip() {
        // where 14px is range handle width
        this.tooltip.style.insetInlineStart = `calc(((100% - 28px) * ${this.input.value / 100}) + 14px)`;
        this.tooltip.textContent = this.value;
    }
